rationale: A second fit has the same training objective/cap as the successful first fit; it may average stochastic estimation or selection error without mixing an unadapted model into an adapted one.

For two equally variable estimators with errorcorrelation rho, averaging variance is sigma_squared*(1+rho)/2. This is a mechanism, not an estimate of the unknown rho or a promise of higher thresholdaccuracy.

The alreadyavailable matched originalOOF saves three repeated fits. Current reviewed relational/query-graph alternatives lack clear residual evidence, making one training-repeat experiment defensible among these particular options.
Only one extra seed provides a limited sensitivity check and possible variance reduction. It does not establish a stable expected advantage, and practical performance within1pp remains the same tier.
counterevidence: Both models start at the identical pretraining checkpoint and train only50steps, so prediction errors may be highlycorrelated and the average may be nearly unchanged.
Raw-plus-adapt averaging did not improve onlineperformance. That is not equivalent to equallyadapted-seed averaging but warns that smooth averages need not preserve the strongest component.
More rawMitra preprocessing views and other small adaptation variants have not reliably improved onlineperformance; no rule says more randomness improves this dataset.

RandomouterCV can share groups across train/query whereas actualtest groups are unseen. The experiment cheaply isolates trainingprogram variability conditional on the oldpartitions; it is not a replacement for deployment-aligned GroupCV.

v81 was selected after many trials and observedonlineperformance. Choosing its ensemble now is adaptive and can regress to the mean. Currentproximity to top5 does not make an estimated.1pp benefit reliable or convert an exploratory upload to stable superiority.
Convexity guarantees equalmean logloss no worse than average componentlogloss, not no worse than the better/old component; meanaccuracy can be worse than either component.
The two seed variants may select different updatecounts because innerpartitions change. Report that difference without selecting the seed/cap afterward.
